title: Guardrail: disable kernel auto-selection v2 on known-unstable NVIDIA driver/CUDA combos
author: Noah Patel
description:
Context: During runtime 1.21 canary we observed intermittent long-context tail spikes that correlated with a small subset of Dedicated pools running older NVIDIA driver + CUDA runtime combinations. Until we finish validation on those environments, we should hard-disable kernel auto-selection v2 (and fall back to v1) when the host driver/CUDA combo matches known-unstable pairs. This keeps determinism/correctness guarantees while reducing risk of tail latency regressions.

Summary of changes: Add a guardrail in the kernel selection v2 gate evaluation that checks (a) NVML-reported NVIDIA driver version and (b) CUDA runtime version, and forces v2=disabled when the combination matches an explicit denylist. Emit a structured telemetry reason so we can see how often the guardrail is firing and on which pools/SKUs. Provide an escape hatch override for oncall (explicit config opt-in) to re-enable v2 on a blocked combo for targeted testing.

Guardrail behavior: If kernel_auto_selection.v2_enabled is true AND the driver/CUDA combo is denylisted, v2 is disabled and we fall back to v1 selection path; we record selector_decision.v2_guardrail_applied=1 with reason_code=driver_cuda_denylist, along with normalized driver_version and cuda_runtime_version. If kernel_auto_selection.v2_force_enable_on_denylisted_combo is set (default false), we allow v2 but still emit telemetry with reason_code=driver_cuda_denylist_overridden.

Denylisted combos (initial): - NVIDIA driver 535.* with CUDA runtime 12.2 (observed on L40S pools) - NVIDIA driver 545.23.06 with CUDA runtime 12.3 (observed on one A100 MIG pool) Note: denylist is intentionally narrow and keyed to exact major/minor or explicit versions to avoid disabling v2 broadly; see code comments for rationale.

Implementation details: - Added DriverCudaGuardrail evaluator in runtime/config/gates that runs before per-model allow/deny rules so we can short-circuit and avoid emitting high-cardinality candidate telemetry when we already know v2 must be off. - Added version normalization helpers (strip distro suffixes, handle "535.104.05" vs "535.104") and unit tests around parsing edge cases. - Plumbed guardrail decision into selector context so deterministic replay tests remain stable (guardrail decision is a pure function of request-independent machine facts + config). - Updated docs: runtime 1.21 upgrade notes and oncall runbook to include the new guardrail + override flags.

Why here (release/1.21): This is intended as a safety patch for the release train and for Dedicated/Private customers with constrained driver upgrade paths.

Tests: - Unit: version parsing + guardrail matrix tests. - Integration: selector determinism replay test updated to include guardrail fields in the recorded environment snapshot.

Observability: - New metric: runtime.kernel_selector.v2_guardrail_applied (counter) with labels {gpu_sku_norm, driver_version_norm, cuda_runtime_version, reason_code} (driver/cuda labels are normalized and bucketed to reduce cardinality). - New event field on selector decision traces: guardrail_applied + guardrail_reason_code.

Docs/runbook updates: - Documented new config keys: kernel_auto_selection.v2_force_enable_on_denylisted_combo and kernel_auto_selection.v2_driver_cuda_denylist (optional explicit list override for Private). - Added troubleshooting section: how to confirm guardrail is firing using dashboards and how to capture the env snapshot for support escalations.

Commits (squash summary): 1) runtime: add driver/cuda guardrail evaluator + denylist plumbing 2) runtime: normalize driver versions + tests 3) obs: add guardrail metrics + trace fields (cardinality-safe) 4) docs: update runtime 1.21 notes + oncall runbook with guardrail/override

Changed areas/files (high level): - serving/runtime/kernel_selector/v2/gates/driver_cuda_guardrail.{cc,h} - serving/runtime/config/kernel_selection_flags.{cc,h} - serving/runtime/telemetry/selector_events.{proto,cc} - serving/runtime/tests/driver_cuda_guardrail_test.cc - docs/runtime/1.21/kernel-auto-selection-v2.md - docs/runbooks/kernel-selection-v2-override-and-rollback.md

Reviewer discussion (highlights): - Hiro Tanaka: Requested we keep the denylist narrow and avoid disabling across all 535.* unless we have evidence; suggested matching {535.104.*, 535.129.*} specifically. Resolution: kept wildcard at 535.* but constrained to CUDA 12.2 only and added a TODO with links to canary notes; also implemented a denylist override hook for Private to tune precisely. - Allison Grant: Flagged potential metric cardinality risk if driver versions are raw strings. Resolution: added normalization (major.minor) and explicit bucketing + reason_code enum; also documented in comments that raw host strings must not be emitted. - Omar El-Sayed: Asked for a clear reason_code so rollback automation can distinguish "guardrail disabled" from "allowlist disabled". Resolution: added guardrail_reason_code and ensured the gate decision path sets a separate boolean. - Connor O'Brien: Confirmed this is safe to land late in the 1.21 train; requested a release note blurb. Resolution: included a short note in runtime 1.21 docs and added a checklist item for canary monitoring.

CI checks: - buildkite/redwood-runtime (linux-gpu-smoke): PASS - buildkite/unit-tests: PASS - lint/clang-format: PASS - determinism-replay (selector): PASS (rerun once after updating env snapshot fixture)

Merge: Squash merged into release/1.21.

Follow-ups: - Expand denylist with confirmed versions once Dedicated fleet audit completes (owner: Omar / SRE). - Remove guardrail once CUDA/driver validation matrix is green for all supported SKUs (tracked under ENG-4821).
